_comment: Candidate playlists are NOT proof of distribution rights. Only pre-reviewed publisher/FAST/public-access hosts or specific channel-ID+host approvals in policy.json can reach generated files. id_style=platform accepts a source's own channel IDs (24-32 hex or US-prefixed) for country-filtered FAST lineups whose guides use those IDs. resolve_redirects sources are resolved through config/redirect_cache.json (see scripts/resolve_redirects.py).
